recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfig(s\[| =)/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleIzzyRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/izzy/release/*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
